title: [Bookgolas Web Parity 14] Build the authenticated five-tab shell and search-mode navigation
declared_commit: feat(shell): add authenticated five-tab consumer shell

red.scenario: The exact consumer-shell acceptance command fails before the shell contract exists.
red.observable: Exit 1 with npm error Missing script: test:consumer-shell.

green.observable: Exit 0; the machine-checkable shell contract passes and 3 Vitest files with 28 tests pass.

criteria.scenario: The authenticated desktop shell exposes exactly Home, My Library, Reading Chart, Calendar and My Page, preserves a localized deep link, opens Book search and Recall, and exposes the timer mount.
criteria.invocation: cd web && npx playwright test tests/e2e/consumer-shell.spec.ts --project=chromium
criteria.observable: Exit 0 with 5 passed; desktop navigation, URL state, search destinations, timer mount, pending/error boundaries, unauthorized data fixture, and expired-session redirect are covered.

criteria.scenario: The mobile shell keeps the same five destinations, uses native compact labels, and cycles Home and Reading Chart re-taps through URL-owned state that survives refresh.
criteria.invocation: cd web && npx playwright test tests/e2e/consumer-shell.spec.ts --project=chromium
criteria.observable: Exit 0 with 5 passed; Korean mobile navigation, Home planned state, Reading Chart pages state, and refresh recovery are covered.

criteria.scenario: An expired authenticated session redirects a refreshed private deep link to localized sign-in with a safe return target.
criteria.invocation: cd web && npx playwright test tests/e2e/consumer-shell.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep expired-session
criteria.observable: Exit 0 with 1 passed; `/en/library?view=records` redirects to `/en/auth/sign-in?returnTo=%2Fen%2Flibrary%3Fview%3Drecords` and does not mount the shell.

verification.invocation: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
verification.observable: TypeScript, ESLint, 23 Vitest files and 182 tests, parity matrix, 59 negative fixtures, BLDS/UI contracts, and the Next production build pass after the feature commit.

surface.observable: Fresh Chromium captures show the desktop search chooser with all five destinations and timer mount, plus Korean dark mobile navigation with five compact tabs and timer.

resolved_issues: Preserve the current query string when switching locales.
Use the project dialog primitive with focus trap, Escape handling, and trigger focus restoration.
Use mode=recall for the contract-defined Recall destination.
Return unavailable before the synthetic user branch while preserving pending synthetic fixture behavior.
